subject: Trading
title: What Is DeFi?
description: Learn What Is DeFi? in one minute.

hook.text: Banks lend, borrow, and trade for you—taking a cut. DeFi replaces them with code that does the same thing.

buildup.text: Decentralized Finance uses smart contracts to create lending, borrowing, and trading without intermediaries.

discovery.text: Platforms like Aave and Compound let anyone earn interest or take a loan—no credit check, no bank approval.

twist.text: But DeFi smart contracts have been hacked for billions. No customer service exists to reverse the damage.

climax.text: DeFi promises financial freedom but demands technical knowledge most users don't yet have.

punchline.text: Be your own bank—with your own risk.

quiz.question: What does DeFi replace with smart contracts?
options: Traditional financial intermediaries like banks and brokers
